payload.posture: Read Luke 4:1–13 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the devil displays the world’s kingdoms, claims authority over them, and asks Jesus for worship. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
